summary: Ucommune International Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 15, 2026, disclosing waiver agreements dated September 14, 2026 with institutional holders of its Series A Convertible Preferred Shares, par value US$0.24 per share. The holders waived certain cash redemption and exchange-cap provisions, and the company elected to lower the fixed conversion price to US$2.59 per Class A ordinary share and the floor price to US$0.518. The filing also corrects prior disclosure, acknowledging the June 11, 2026 Series B Exchange was void ab initio, leaving 1,330 Series A Preferred Shares outstanding. This is a capital structure and disclosure-correction event, not a special situation; watch for potential dilution and overhang from the lowered conversion price.
